query:
SELECT f.id, f.user_id, f.friend_id, f.status, u1.name as user_name, u2.name as friend_name
FROM friendships f
JOIN users u1 ON f.user_id = u1.id
JOIN users u2 ON f.friend_id = u2.id
WHERE f.status = 'accepted'
LIMIT 20;
